step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Vodafone New Zealand's cloud contact center solution migrated to AWS. Customers connect to Amazon Connect, which uses Amazon Lex for intent recognition and conversational AI. Connect invokes Lambda functions, which query DynamoDB for dynamic modular contact flow stitching. Connect streams contact trace records, Contact Lens sentiment analysis, and transcripts into Snowflake, which feeds interactive Dashboards for Agents, Team Leads, and Developers. Developers push infrastructure-as-code deployments through AWS DevTools and Terraform to manage AWS resources automatically.

graph.name: Vodafone New Zealand Cloud Contact Center Migration
graph.notes: Migrated from legacy on-premise contact center to AWS Amazon Connect, reducing interaction pathways from 81,000 to 200 Lex intents for 2,500 agents and over 1 million monthly calls.

nodes.name: CUSTOMER
nodes.notes: Handles over 1 million incoming phone calls and chats per month.

nodes.name: CONNECT
nodes.notes: Core contact center service managing voice and chat channels via modular universal contact flows.

nodes.name: LEX
nodes.notes: Conversational AI and intent matching simplified to around 200 intents.

nodes.name: SNOWFLAKE
nodes.notes: Central data warehouse storing CTR attributes, Contact Lens sentiment analysis, and transcriptions.

nodes.name: DASHBOARD
nodes.notes: Visualization dashboard serving analytics to agents, team leads, and developers.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Executes logic to stitch modular contact flows dynamically.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores dynamic flow mappings and contact flow configurations.

nodes.name: TERRAFORM
nodes.notes: Infrastructure as Code tool used to deploy Connect flows, Lex intents, Lambda, and DynamoDB.

nodes.name: DEV TOOLS
nodes.notes: AWS CI/CD pipeline tools automating testing and continuous delivery.

nodes.name: AGENTS
nodes.notes: 2,500 customer service agents across 3 geographic locations.

nodes.name: TEAM LEADS
nodes.notes: Supervisors monitoring contact center performance and operational metrics.

nodes.name: DEVELOPER
nodes.notes: Engineers iterating on infrastructure and flow updates using continuous feedback loops.

edges.notes: Customer initiates voice or chat contact into Amazon Connect.
Connect passes customer interactions to Lex for intent recognition.
Lex routes resolved interactions or hands off calls/chats to customer agents.
Connect invokes Lambda functions to retrieve routing logic.
Lambda reads dynamic flow mappings from DynamoDB.
Connect streams Contact Lens data, CTRs, and transcripts to Snowflake.
Snowflake feeds consolidated customer and interaction metrics to Dashboard.
Dashboard displays real-time operational views to Agents.
Dashboard provides supervisory metrics to Team Leads.
Dashboard provides continuous information feedback to Developers.
Developers push code and configuration through AWS DevTools.
DevTools pipeline triggers Terraform to deploy updated AWS infrastructure and contact flows.
